**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/sprouts/product - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Sprouts Farmers Market product by its product link: the product id, name, brand, description, images, the price in US dollars and stock. The product record carries no rating; the rating and review count are on the product's row in GET /v1/sprouts/search.

**Use when** you want to read the detail of a product found in Sprouts search or shared as a link.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - The product's link on shop.sprouts.com, for example https://shop.sprouts.com/store/sprouts/products/1377249-almond-breeze-unsweetened-original-almondmilk-96-fl-oz. Every row of GET /v1/sprouts/search carries it as product.url. · e.g. `https://shop.sprouts.com/store/sprouts/products/1377249-almond-breeze-unsweetened-original-almondmilk-96-fl-oz`
- `store_id` (optional, string) - Sprouts store id (digits, for example 17650) whose catalog, prices and stock to read. Without it a default store is used; product.ext.sprouts.store_id names the store either way.

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.description` | Product description. |

+8 more (types in the full schema): `product` {image_urls, reviews_count}; `product.ext` {sprouts}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `product.seller`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/sprouts/product" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://shop.sprouts.com/store/sprouts/products/1377249-almond-breeze-unsweetened-original-almondmilk-96-fl-oz" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/sprouts/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Sprouts Farmers Market products for a keyword search from one store, 24 a page for up to 100 pages: the product id, name, brand, product link, image, the price in US dollars with the regular price when the item is on sale, stock, and the star rating with its review count. `product.ext.sprouts` adds the UPC, the pack size and the store the prices are from. Consecutive pages can repeat a few products, so de-duplicate by `product.id` when crawling. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to compare natural and organic grocery prices or collect products with their ratings.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 24/page · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/24) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Product keywords, 1 to 200 characters, for example almond milk. · e.g. `almond milk`
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Page number from 1 to 100. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `store_id` (optional, string) - Sprouts store id (digits, for example 17650) whose catalog, prices and stock to read. Without it a default store is used; product.ext.sprouts.store_id names the store either way.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.description` | Product description. |

+8 more (types in the full schema): `product` {image_urls, reviews_count}; `product.ext` {sprouts}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `product.seller`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/sprouts/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=almond milk" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
